tasks.gr8-whole-numbers-and-integers-t1: Topic: Whole numbers and integers. Cover operations, place value, order of operations, and contextual gain/loss situations. Ask Grade 8 learners to apply sign rules accurately and explain integer reasoning in practical contexts.
tasks.gr8-exponents-t1: Topic: Exponents. Cover laws of exponents, square and cube numbers, and equivalent exponential forms. Ask Grade 8 learners to simplify powers correctly and connect notation to value.
tasks.gr8-numeric-and-geometric-patterns-funct: Topic: Numeric and geometric patterns; functions and relationships. Cover pattern rules, tables, input-output mapping, and relationship descriptions. Ask Grade 8 learners to find rules, generalise pattern growth, and justify missing-value answers.
tasks.gr8-algebraic-expressions-and-equations-: Topic: Algebraic expressions and equations. Cover like terms, substitution, expansion, and solving linear equations. Ask Grade 8 learners to convert words to algebra and solve equations using clear steps.
tasks.gr8-scientific-notation-t1: Topic: Scientific notation. Cover writing large whole numbers as a × 10^n with 1 ≤ a < 10 and positive exponents only, counting the places the comma moves, writing scientific notation as an ordinary number, and comparing numbers by exponent first. Ask Grade 8 learners to use South African decimal commas and exact whole-number answers.
tasks.gr8-ratio-and-rate-t1: Topic: Ratio and rate. Cover simplifying a ratio of two quantities of the same kind, sharing a whole in a given ratio, increasing or decreasing a number in a ratio, and rates including speed, distance and time and best buy. Use whole-number answers and rands with a decimal comma.
tasks.gr8-percentages-and-financial-t1: Topic: Percentages and financial contexts. Cover a percentage of an amount, increase and decrease, profit, loss and discount, VAT at 15% (adding it and removing it by dividing by 115), and simple budgets. Use rands with a decimal comma and exact amounts.
tasks.gr8-interest-hire-purchase-exchange-t1: Topic: Simple interest, loans, hire purchase and exchange rates. Calculate simple interest by repeated calculation (one year, then repeat), not with a formula; compound interest is Grade 9. Cover loans, hire purchase (deposit plus instalments compared with the cash price) and exchange rates in both directions. Use rands with a decimal comma and exact amounts.
